name: zerodha-clone
description: MERN paper-trading platform: landing site, trading dashboard and Express/MongoDB API with Finnhub market data

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix dashboard install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,dash -c blue,green,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix dashboard run dev"
scripts.dev:local: concurrently -n api,web,dash -c blue,green,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev:local" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix dashboard run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix dashboard run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix dashboard run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix dashboard test
scripts.build:single: cross-env VITE_API_URL= VITE_DASHBOARD_URL=/app npm --prefix frontend run build && cross-env VITE_API_URL= VITE_LANDING_URL= VITE_BASE_PATH=/app/ npm --prefix dashboard run build
